# Notation 2

Notation 2 brings Notion-style visuals to Obsidian, including cover or banner images, transparent callouts and subtle outlines. Colored callouts and collapsible toggle blocks are written through a simple bracketed syntax, and callout headings are scaled for larger text.

![Notation 2 screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bluemoondragon07/obsidian-notation-2/HEAD/cover-small.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Notation 2"
    author: "bluemoondragon07"
    repo:   "bluemoondragon07/obsidian-notation-2"
    slug:   "notation-2"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/notation-2"

    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bluemoondragon07/obsidian-notation-2/HEAD/cover-small.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Bring Notion-style visuals to Obsidian with cover (banner) images, transparent callouts, and subtle outlines. Create colored callouts and collapsible toggle blocks via simple bracketed syntax, and scale callout headings for larger text."
}
```
